content_metadata.description: A step-by-step instructional video tutorial on how to transfer your Metro service to a new phone using the 'My Metro' app.

qAndA.question: What does the presenter recommend using to remove the SIM card from the phone if you don't have the tool provided in the box?
How much does it cost to have your service switched over if you don't buy a phone from Metro?
What can you look for in the status bar of the new phone to confirm the transfer is complete?

qAndA.answer: Open the My Metro app and check if it is displaying your account information.
qAndA.question: Besides making a test call, how else can you confirm your service is active on the new phone?
What is the name of the app used for switching the phone?
